     - Input validation: checks for null bytes, enforces size limits, validates escape sequences
     - Line/column tracking for improved error messages
     - Escape sequence validation with proper error reporting for invalid sequences
     - Comprehensive test cases validating all security limits
     - Better error handling using Result types instead of unwrap()
     
   - **tests/lexer_test.rs** (25 unit tests, 1,200+ lines)
     - Token type validation: keywords (8), identifiers, integers, floats, strings with escapes, booleans, operators (19), delimiters (9)
     - Edge case tests: empty input, whitespace only, multiple comments, large input performance
     - Error tests: unterminated strings, invalid characters
     - Performance tests: 1000-line input processing

     - Complex feature tests: function calls, multiple statements, type definitions, operator precedence
     - Advanced tests: string literals, floating point, comments, multiple functions, empty blocks
     - Performance test: full pipeline compilation performance validation

**Status**: 🟢 Initializing | **Language**: Rust | **Repository**: https://gogs.dclub.kr/kim/fv-lang.git

---

## 🎯 Vision

A functional-first programming language with expressive syntax, strong type inference, and memory safety.

```
FV-Lang = Functional Paradigm + Value Semantics + Performance
```

---

## ✨ Key Features (Planned)

- ✅ Function-oriented design
- ✅ Pattern matching
- ✅ Type inference
- ✅ Immutable-by-default
- ✅ Memory safe
- ✅ Expressive syntax

---

## 📊 Project Status

| Phase | Component | Status |
|-------|-----------|--------|
| 1 | Lexer | 🟡 Planned |
| 2 | Parser | 🟡 Planned |
| 3 | Type System | 🟡 Planned |
| 4 | Code Generation | 🟡 Planned |
| 5 | Standard Library | 🟡 Planned |

---

```
Source Code (.fv)
    ↓ [Lexer]
Tokens
    ↓ [Parser]
Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)
    ↓ [Type Checker]
Typed AST
    ↓ [Code Generator]
IR / Native Code
    ↓ [Optimizer]
Executable

**FV-Lang**은 함수형 프로그래밍을 중심으로 설계된 현대적 프로그래밍 언어입니다. Haskell, Lisp, ML의 영향을 받아 순수 함수, 불변성, 패턴 매칭을 핵심으로 합니다.

**주요 특징**:
- ✅ **순수 함수형** - Side effect 없는 함수 중심
- ✅ **불변 데이터** - 기본값이 immutable
- ✅ **패턴 매칭** - 강력한 패턴 인식
- ✅ **고차 함수** - First-class 함수, 클로저
- ✅ **타입 안전** - 정적 타입 시스템

---

## 특징

### 핵심 기능

| 기능 | 설명 |
|------|------|
| **순수 함수** | 입력에만 의존하는 함수 |
| **불변성** | 기본값이 불변, 재할당 불가 |
| **패턴 매칭** | `match` 식으로 패턴 분석 |
| **고차 함수** | 함수를 인자/반환값으로 사용 |
| **레이지 평가** | 필요할 때만 계산 |
